name: @hasna/sheets
description: Headless spreadsheet SDK for Hasna-coded apps — a framework-agnostic workbook model with an MIT formula engine (fast-formula-parser), CSV/XLSX/JSON import-export, plus a react-spreadsheet editor shipped from the ./react export

scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run build:lib && bun run build:react && bun run build:cli && bun run build:types
scripts.build:lib: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target bun --external fast-formula-parser --external nanoid --external exceljs
scripts.build:react: bun build src/react.tsx --outdir dist --target bun --external react --external react-dom --external react-spreadsheet --external scheduler --external fast-formula-parser --external nanoid --external exceljs
scripts.build:cli: bun build src/cli/index.ts --outdir dist/cli --target bun --external fast-formula-parser --external commander --external nanoid --external exceljs
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:dashboard

author: hasna
